title: Minimal Continuation Reduction Algorithm

basis.scope: Minimal reduction procedure for well-formed continuation expressions after evaluation admits composition and reduction.

core_rule.statement: Reduction is algorithmically ordered after EVAL_024; every lawful step preserves ≡P; guard failure returns classified ⊥C_x; termination, confluence, and the normalization-status taxonomy remain deferred.

purpose: Define the first minimal algorithm for reducing well-formed continuation expressions toward NF(C) after the evaluation pipeline admits composition and reduction.

canonical_claims.statement: Reduction is algorithmically ordered after evaluation.
The algorithm may return a partial normal-form candidate when full normalization is not yet proven.
No termination or confluence proof is asserted by this patch.

formal_objects.name: Minimal Continuation Reduction Algorithm
formal_objects.definition: A minimal governed iterative procedure for reducing well-formed continuation expressions toward NF(C) after EVAL_024 admits composition and reduction.

algorithm: If any guard fails, return classified ⊥C_x.
If expression contains identity composition, apply identity reduction.
If expression contains lawful composed continuation C(A,B) ∘ C(B,C), reduce to C(A,C).
Repeat lawful reductions while process equivalence is preserved.
Return NF(C) if no further lawful reductions are available.
If normalization cannot be completed, return partial_NF(C) with unresolved status.
